svg.aria-label: A long plank workbench laid out as a construction yard, with a narrow-gauge site railway along its front. From left to right: a drafting desk with a computer and the name Ishmael Ngetich inked on the wood; a bridge being launched across three piers over a model river; a lattice tower rising ring by ring on its blueprint beside a tower crane; a services yard with three working bays; a water tower whose meter counts active users; and the site gate with a gatehouse, mailbox and intercom.
